cohort: Live births at a tertiary maternity hospital in the United Kingdom between 2000 and 2016
finding: Forceps delivery, ventouse delivery, and emergency cesarean section were significantly associated with an increased risk of facial nerve injury, while birth weight, forceps delivery, and ventouse delivery were associated with brachial plexus injury.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery and ventouse delivery were associated with both facial nerve injury and brachial plexus injury.
